description: This file defines a service layer for user-related database operations including listing, fetching, creating, updating, and deleting users using SQLAlchemy ORM.

methods.name: List[User] list_users(db: Session, limit: int = 100, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of users from the database.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their ID.

methods.name: User create_user(db: Session, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database with provided details.

methods.name: User update_user(db: Session, user: User, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Partially updates an existing user's details.

methods.name: None delete_user(db: Session, user: User)
methods.description: Deletes a specified user from the database.

ctags.name: create_user
ctags.pattern: /^def create_user(db: Session, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> User:$/

ctags.name: list_users
ctags.pattern: /^def list_users(db: Session, limit: int = 100, offset: int = 0) -> List[User]:$/

ctags.name: update_user
ctags.pattern: /^def update_user(db: Session, user: User, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> User:$/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, user: User, data: Dict[str, Any])
